claims.body: The Golden Knights played last night and get no rest before this one. Teams in that spot usually get the worse of the chances, so we expect the Predators to control more of the play than they usually do.

claims.head: The Golden Knights should tilt the ice
claims.body: The Golden Knights have been one of the league’s best at controlling the chances at 5-on-5, and the Predators near the bottom. Expect the Golden Knights to spend more of the night in the Predators’ end. That’s about the puck, not the scoreboard: goalies and finishing decide plenty of games the chances don’t.

NSH.head: The Predators face a real test
NSH.body: Even though Vegas is on the second night of a back-to-back and Nashville has home-ice advantage, the Golden Knights have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Predators’ best way through is keeping dangerous shots away.

VGK.body: Even though Vegas is on the second night of a back-to-back and Nashville has home-ice advantage, the Golden Knights have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Predators’ way back in is keeping dangerous shots away.

items.text: Shea Theodore has a point in seven straight games against Nashville.
The Golden Knights have been without Victor Olofsson since Oct 6.
The Predators are newly without Mavrik Bourque, and have had to make do without Justus Annunen all season. Juuse Saros is expected to start.
Jack Eichel is one assist from passing Jonathan Marchessault for fourth on the Golden Knights’ all-time assists list.
